description: Extract the main article from a web page (Readability-style content scoring, no headless browser): clean body text with paragraph breaks plus title, byline, site name, published/modified dates, language, excerpt, lead image, word count and reading time. Navigation, ads, share bars, comments and related-links blocks are stripped; JSON-LD articleBody is used when it is fuller. SSRF-safe fetch. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/readability-extract

paragraphs.description: Also return the text as a paragraphs array (default false)
